title: GrantThai MCP tools — CONTRACT ONLY (implementation ships v0.4)
description: Defines the future MCP tool surface as a one-to-one wrapper over the same library functions the CLI uses (docs/design/PLAN.md §G). No implementation before v0.4. Hard rules: (1) no MCP tool may set any field's status above DRAFT (spec/common/status_permissions.yaml, hard_ceiling); (2) no MCP tool can submit anything to NRIIS; (3) tools whose CLI counterpart would persist a validator status (validate) are REPORT-ONLY over MCP: they return a validation report and persist nothing (status_effect: none). The CLI and MCP share the same checking code, so the findings are identical; only persistence differs.

wraps_cli_command.description: Must name an existing human CLI command (spec/common/parity.yaml requires a tested human equivalent).

status_effect.description: none = report-only, persists nothing; draft_only = may write field values at status DRAFT or below.
